pinnedMathlibReuse.correction: LinearMap.IsPerfectCompl U V asserts that U complements the transported annihilator of V, and conversely. If U equals that annihilator, IsPerfectCompl would assert IsCompl U U, which is not the wanted global-duality relation. LinearMap.IsPerfPair.restrict is therefore not a shortcut from global orthogonality to Poitou-Tate. Use annihilator equality and quotient/dimension arguments; apply restrict only to actual complementary nondegenerate subspaces with its hypotheses proved.

discharged: Under the displayed compact Hausdorff Noetherian local coefficient assumptions, the coefficientwise topology on the actual finite-variable power-series ring is compact and maximal-adic. The original residue algebra identification derives locality of the coefficient map. The same residue-one character differences derive locality of the actual fixed parameter action. The compact separated ring-hom theorem then proves continuity in the original coefficient topologies, independently of the auxiliary discrete coefficient topology used to construct the algebra map.

The actual arithmetic ring supplies its own Noetherianity, compactness, Hausdorff topology and residue comparison. The final exact selected-family consumer retains the scalar-compatible original ring quotient and now constructs the local continuous action and the compact Noetherian adic complete common parameter algebra.

The fixed base maximal ideal has one chosen finite generating set. Lifting it through the actual augmentation quotient and adjoining the genuine fixed parameter images generates each auxiliary maximal ideal with at most the fixed number of parameter directions plus the base generator count.

Pinned Ideal.index_pow_le gives explicit bounds on every original maximal-adic quotient from those generators. The bound is the fixed residue-field cardinality raised to the geometric sum of powers of the fixed generator bound, so it is independent of the selected primes and auxiliary level. No uniform size certificate is supplied.

The final actual arithmetic consumer selects good prime families at every positive level, retaining exact cardinality, finite avoidance, original local dimensions and the zero common dual-Selmer kernel. It derives the exact Algebra.UniformlyBoundedRank class for their genuine enlarged-support fixed-determinant rings from the constructed quotient comparisons.

Surjective maps to genuine local deformation quotients induce surjections on every maximal-adic quotient. The actual original arithmetic family supplies Noetherianity and finite residue fields, so its proved uniform rank descends to any such quotient family without a supplied rank or finiteness certificate.
